answer: Bonded attestation: to join, an agent locks collateral in the lagoon reserve and receives a crystal registry entry; every claim it files is then audited by a zephyr round, a jury of randomly drawn bonded peers, and a false attestation burns the bond. An attacker splitting one fixed budget across N sybils shrinks each bond by 1/N, while the odds a zephyr jury catches collusion climb with N, because the fakes form a closed clique that only vouches inward, so clustering isolates and slashes them wholesale.
